arguments.summary: Critical SIEM storage failure detected during investigation of a compromised host (WS-FIN-042, IP: 10.0.5.42) exhibiting Cobalt Strike beaconing behavior. Concurrently, the SIEM hot storage array (10.0.9.25) was found to be in imminent failure, threatening loss of 847 GB of critical forensic logs. Emergency log export was attempted but denied due to policy restrictions. Immediate action is required to preserve evidence and contain the breach.
